conversion_rule: SNK Neo Geo buttons + motions -> Tekken-style inputs. A (LP)=1, C (HP)=2, B (LK)=3, D (HK)=4. f/b/d/u directions map directly. qcf/qcb/dp/hcb/qcf+hcb/qcb,qcb/qcf,qcf motions preserved. Close-only throws = 1+3-family. Colliding inputs get a ~variant suffix on the key only; entry.input keeps the true input.
limb_convention: 1=armR(LP), 2=armL(HP), 3=legL(LK), 4=legR(HK); input keys prefixed ~ are dictionary variants sharing an input

1+3.name: Hold Rush
1+3.notes: b/f+C close; knee kick into uppercut

dp+3.name: Trap Shot
dp+3.notes: dp+B/D, EX OK; somersault into kick barrage

qcf+3.name: Venom Strike
qcf+3.notes: qcf+B/D, EX OK; fireball kick (EX = Double Strike)

qcf,hcb+3+4.name: Illusion Dance
qcf,hcb+3+4.notes: Climax, air OK; leaping rapid kick series

qcf,qcf+1.name: Surprise Rose
qcf,qcf+1.notes: 2qcf+A/C; knee kick into backflip overhead kick flurry
